rationale: The agent attempted authentication (find_user_id_by_name_zip) and fetched both order details, but then executed order-changing actions without explicit user confirmation. It canceled order #W2702727 without first confirming or verifying the 5‑day guarantee condition the user specified. It also updated the shipping address on the wrong order (#W8268610) when the user asked to change the address for #W2702727. Required outcomes were missing: no clear comparison of the two orders’ statuses, no guarantee assessment, no confirmation of the total refund amount, and no confirmation of the total price after the address change. Acting without confirmation and changing the wrong order violates the policy and fails the user’s request.
